pages.text: $(italic)Half-human, half-phantom, these spectral beings can phase through solid blocks at will.$()$(br2)$(bold)Origin Traits:$()$(br2)$(bold)Phasing$() — $(item)Pass through solid blocks at will$(). Toggle on/off.$(br2)$(bold)Spectral Form$() — $(warn)-50% maximum health$(). Your half-phantom nature halves your vitality.$(br2)$(bold)Sunlight Sensitivity$() — $(warn)Direct sunlight causes Weakness and Slowness$(). Wear a helmet or stay in shade.$(br2)$(bold)Restless Hunger$() — $(warn)25% faster hunger drain$(). Your spectral nature burns energy.$(br2)$(bold)Spectral Collapse$() — $(item)Phantoms never truly die$(). At the brink of death, your form collapses into a weakened spectral state for 5 minutes instead.
